liveAuctionUrl.description: Approved external Live Auction destination (PUB-27, D01-ASM-002). Absent when no destination is approved — the account-gated Live Auction entry is hidden, never a placeholder link (RULE-10).

SessionClaims.description: Stand-in demo JWT claims (DEC-PUB-AUTH-BOUNDARY). Never a production identity.

reason.description: Machine-readable reservation failure code (D01-P06-T004): unauthenticated, forbidden, vehicle_not_found, vehicle_unavailable, conflict, duplicate, limit_exceeded.

consent.description: Required (D01-P06-T002, PUB-14): explicit agreement to be contacted, validated server-side beyond native browser checks.

LeadRecord.description: Canonical staff-visible lead record (PUB-16, D01-P06-T001) — the regression fix proving a submitted enquiry is retrievable through the Salesperson service boundary.

message.example: Please send a shipping quotation for this vehicle.

ReservationRequest.description: PUB-23, RULE-05, D01-P06-T004: a transactional 48-hour reservation hold request for the authenticated demo customer.

ReservationResponse.description: A persisted reservation hold. `status` is always computed live from `expiresAt` versus the current instant — DEC-PUB-RESERVATION-EXPIRY-ACTION is OPEN, so no automatic release action is ever claimed to have occurred (RULE-10).

Invoice.description: Customer invoice record linked to vehicle and status.

Allocation.description: Payment allocation to an invoice, with approval status.

CustomerDashboard.description: Customer dashboard aggregate with linked record KPIs (D02-ASM-001, D02-P02-T001). Outstanding balance = issued invoice total - approved allocations. Credit utilisation = outstanding balance ÷ credit limit. Vehicle counts use canonical IDs and server status. Payment/shipment/document/notification summaries computed from linked records. Freshness metadata and partial failure indicators included. Server-derived; no browser calculation.

paymentStatusSummary.description: Count of payments linked to customer invoices by status

shipmentStatusSummary.description: Count of shipments linked to customer vehicles by status

documentAvailabilityCount.description: Count of documents linked to customer shipments/vehicles by availability status

notificationUnreadCount.description: Count of unread notifications for this customer

partialFailureIndicators.description: Flags indicating if any linked-record query failed; missing/empty lists are not failures
